hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in */frontend/src/api/generated/*) exit 0 ;; */frontend/src/routeTree.gen.ts) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */frontend/src/*.ts|*/frontend/src/*.tsx|*/frontend/src/*.css|*/frontend/src/*.json) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root="$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -z "$root" ] && exit 0; cd "$root/frontend" && pnpm exec biome check --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
